name: Gravebound Greatblade
languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The greatblade makes two attacks, using Greatsword or Hurl Greatsword in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Gravebound Cleave.

Actions.name: Greatsword
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 21 (5d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

Actions.name: Hurl Greatsword
Actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 60/240 ft. 18 (4d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

Actions.name: Gravebound Cleave
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 14, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation. *Failure:* 28 (8d6) Slashing damage. *Success:* Half damage only.
Actions.clause: When the greatblade makes a Greatsword attack, it can put both hands to the hilt and let the blade ride through the swin
Actions.expresses: relentless two-handed cleaving that never retreats

Traits.name: Great Weapon Master
Traits.text: When the greatblade hits a creature with its Greatsword, the attack deals an extra 3 damage.

lore: Raised from a battlefield's bleaching dead to stand eternal guard, it still grips the greatsword it fell with, long after the necromancer who bound it has crumbled to dust.

generation.cite: composition after Hill Giant (CR 5) — two of the same swing, thrown rock
